Vendored dependencies for the widget. These are plain browser-ready files, not npm packages —
the widget loads them with a plain `<script>` tag at runtime, no bundler needed.

- `gsap.min.js` — [GSAP](https://gsap.com) 3.15.0, used for the mascot's peek/open/close
  animation. Free for commercial use under GreenSock's
  [standard "no charge" license](https://gsap.com/standard-license) (the entire toolset became
  free, including for commercial use, in April 2025). Not modified from the official build.
